text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Big Brother...!
How was that?!"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Big sis...!
How did I do?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
If you ask Curren,
I think I ran pretty darn well!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It certainly was a good run, and she produced
the results we expected. But... that's only
true up to this distance.
choice_data_list: Honestly, I think any more than this would be too much.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Curren, after all...
really wants the Triple Tiara.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Remembering just how deeply committed she was,
it pained me to deliver this decision."
choice_data_list: It's not like there's zero chance, but—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
No, it's fine.
I'm okay.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Understood.
Then let's give up on the Triple Tiara!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There was no sign of resignation or compromise in Curren Chan's expression.
All that was there... was a positive, radiant sparkle,
gazing toward a brand-new future.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
The Tiara is a fleeting glimmer found only in the Classic year.
We cannot afford to wait for 'someday possibilities.'

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Curren trusts Onii-chan's judgment.
Besides—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Curren trusts Onee-chan's judgment.
Besides—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
All I need to do is shine brighter
than any tiara. Right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Discarding an ideal once envisioned is difficult.
Even so, I was deeply moved once again by her strength in striving forward."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
It's decided!
From now on, Curren is fully devoted to sprint races!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I'll snag a cute little win,
and pave a path even cuter than a Tiaraâª

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Now that our direction was set, there was a race
I wanted to propose to Curren Chan. That race was—
choice_data_list: I want to aim for the Sprinters Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The short-distance GⅠ, the Sprinters Stakes.
I wanted to set this race, which decides the
ultimate sprinter, as our major goal.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Wah, a GⅠ! Sounds great.
It's a perfect fit for Curren's new dream!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
That's right!
A new dream to replace the Tiara.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
—"I'll win on the grandest stage
and become the most beloved Umamusume of all!" ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! No matter what race it is,
the most loved Umamusume is still the cutest, no question.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Bathed in the spotlight of the grand stage,
basking in the roaring cheers of the crowd...
That's when Curren becomes the most adorable!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Curren might be getting fired up♪
I'll do my best
to become the number-one beloved girl!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Curren Chan's thinking really is completely out of left field.
GⅠ races aren't that forgiving, though...
Will she really be okay like this?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Ah, but... there's quite a big gap until that race, isn't there?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Zero exposure during that time would be pretty lonely, so... I'd like to pick out some other target races too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I was actually hoping to suggest that myself.
To run alongside training as a stepping stone toward our ultimate goal, the race I'd choose is—
choice_data_list: Why not run in the Aoi Stakes?
Would you like to run in the Aoi Stakes?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While it's a step down in class compared to this race,
it should be just the right opportunity to regain her feel for the 1,200m distance.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Got it!
That's the first step to becoming number one in everyone's hearts.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, our next target was set for the Aoi Stakes!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
...That said, just races alone won't be enough...
Maybe I should set 'that' in motion.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"It's nothing~.
Let's do our best, Big Brother♪"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"It's nothing~.
Let's do our best, Big Sister♪"
